newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica adds non-customer ATM fee.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica adds non-customer ATM fee.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said on Friday that beginning November 17, it will charge $1.50 per cash withdrawal by non-customers who use the bank's Versateller ATM network in California, Oregon, Washington, Idaho, and Hawaii.
It said the fee will not affect Bank of America Versateller cardholders who use the bank's ATM network free of transaction charges.

The fee will not be charged at many Versateller ATMs at retail outlets, including nearly 500 ATMs in Lucky Stores throughout California. The company operates a total of nearly 7,000 ATMs throughout its franchise.
